content.title: Patrick Muldoon cause of death: How did Melrose Place star die?
content.text: POP-CULTUREPatrick Muldoon cause of death: What we know about 'Melrose Place' star Charles CurtisFor The WinApril 20, 2026, 7:29 a.m. ET0:24/0:43Patrick Muldoon -- with a resume filled with memorable roles from Saved By the Bell to Starship Troopers to Melrose Place to nearly 500 episodes of Days of Our Lives as Austin Reed -- died at the age of 57.Variety reports that his manager confirmed the news. What was the cause of death? Per Deadline, it was "following a heart attack" and it happened on Sunday morning. And TMZ spoke with Muldoon's sister Shana Muldoon-Zappa, who said that Muldoon's girlfriend "found him unconscious on [the] bathroom floor" after the actor went to take a shower.It's awful news for fans of the beloved actor.
